desc.cn: 该图标表明当前蚀刻章可被重锻，重锻方式如图鉴所示。
desc.en: Medals with such icons can be reforged. Follow the steps in the Medal Album to reforge them.

desc.cn: 重锻后，蚀刻章等级和外观会发生改变。
desc.en: Reforging the engraved medal changes its level and appearance.

desc.cn: 该图标表明当前蚀刻章可被镀层，镀层方式如图鉴所示。
desc.en: Medals with such icons can be trimmed. Follow the steps in the Medal Album to trim them.

desc.cn: 镀层后，蚀刻章外观会发生改变。
desc.en: Trimming the engraved medal changes its appearance.

desc.cn: 此图标代表该蚀刻章可被激活止境认证，仅部分高珍贵度蚀刻章具备激活资格。
desc.en: Medals with such icons can undergo Verification of Finality. This is only available to a number of rare medals.

desc.cn: 在限定期间达成该蚀刻章重锻方式Ⅲ时，即可激活止境认证。
desc.en: Complete Reforging Ⅲ of the engraved medal to verify Finality

desc.cn: 若后续新增更高珍贵度的蚀刻章，该蚀刻章的止境认证资格将被永久解除并移至新蚀刻章。
desc.en: If engraved medals of higher rarities are added in the future, the Verification of Finality of the medal will be permanently removed and transferred to the new medal instead.

desc.cn: 新蚀刻章重新达成重锻方式Ⅲ后，方可再次激活止境认证。
desc.en: Complete Reforging Ⅲ of the new engraved medal to re-verify its Finality.

desc.cn:
在危机合约中，“指标”是一系列会提升挑战难度的效果，分为3档难度等级。
管理员可以自由选择指标组合，调节不同难度，进行战斗挑战。
desc.en: The Contingency Contract Test Criteria are a series of effects that make challenges more difficult. Test Criteria are divided into 3 difficulty tiers. Select any combination of Test Criteria to tweak the difficulty before starting the combat challenge.

desc.cn:
指标会存在一些选择上的限制。部分指标之间存在冲突关系，最多只能选择其中一个。
同时还有部分指标，需要在达成特定指标等级后，或在特定时间后，才会开放。
desc.en: There may be selection limits for certain Test Criteria. Some Test Criteria conflict with another, forcing you to choose between one of them. Some are only available when Test Criteria Level is high enough, or after a specified date.

title.cn: 危机合约 - 选择指标的限制
title.en: Contingency Contract: Test Criterion Selection Limit

desc.cn: 部分指标是特殊的「锁闭指标」，初始情况不可选择，必须先选择「密钥指标」才能解锁。
desc.en: Some Test Criteria are [Locked Criteria] that cannot be selected by default. Select the specified [Key Criteria] to unlock them.

title.cn: 危机合约 - 锁闭指标与密钥指标

desc.cn: 成功完成每项指标的首次挑战，可获得相应的晶化硬币奖励；更多晶化硬币奖励可通过完成合约任务获得。晶化硬币可用于在机密圣所兑换活动奖励。
desc.en: Successfully completing a challenge with a Test Criterion for the first time provides a reward of Vitrified Coins. More Vitrified Coins can be earned by completing Contract Missions. Vitrified Coins are exchangeable for event rewards at the Secret Sanctuary.

title.cn: 危机合约 - 挑战奖励

desc.cn: 潜地虬兽与原生钳兽死亡时，其毒液会残留在地面，对<@gd.key>毒液范围内的单位造成伤害及减速效果。</>
desc.en: When the Tunneling Nidwyrm or Indigenous Pincerbeast is killed, the slain creature's venom will linger on the ground. <@gd.key>The venom deals DMG and applies Slow to any unit within its area of effect.</>

title.cn: 生存特训 - 物以类聚

desc.cn: 利用工业爆炸物击败来袭的敌人，保护物资。
desc.en: Use Industrial Explosives to defeat the attacking enemies and protect the supplies.

desc.cn: 火雾源石虫死亡时会<@gd.key>吸附周围的敌人</>，善加利用可显著提升战斗效率。
desc.en: When killed, the Firemist Originium Slug <@gd.key>pulls in nearby enemies</>. Use this well to boost your combat efficiency.

desc.cn: 酸液源石虫·α<@gd.key>抵达漂浮源石处会自爆造成大量伤害</>，需要小心，其死亡时会<@gd.key>吸附周围的敌人</>，善加利用可显著提升战斗效率。
desc.en: Careful! When Acid Originium Slug α <@gd.key>reaches the floating Originium, it explodes to deal massive DMG</>. When killed, the creature also <@gd.key>pulls in nearby enemies</>. Use this well to boost your combat efficiency.

title.cn: 生存特训 - 虫海求生

desc.cn: 利用工业爆炸物击败来袭的敌人，保护物资。
desc.en: Use Industrial Explosives to defeat the attacking enemies and protect the supplies.

title.cn: 生存特训 - 多向爆破

desc.cn: 原生钳兽死亡时会<@gd.key>对周围的敌人持续造成伤害</>，善加利用可显著提升战斗效率。
desc.en: When killed, the Indigenous Pincerbeast <@gd.key>continuously deals DMG to nearby enemies</>. Use this well to boost your combat efficiency.

title.cn: 生存特训 - 多向爆破

desc.cn: 火雾源石虫死亡时会<@gd.key>吸附周围的敌人</>，善加利用可显著提升战斗效率。
desc.en: When killed, the Firemist Originium Slug <@gd.key>pulls in nearby enemies</>. Use this well to boost your combat efficiency.

title.cn: 生存特训 - 多向爆破

desc.cn: 引诱斧甲兽撞击酸液源石虫，使酸液源石虫进入<@gd.key>失衡状态</>后，再利用<@gd.key>处决伤害</>或者斧甲兽的撞击击败酸液源石虫。
desc.en: Position yourself so that the Axe Armorbeast rams and applies <@gd.key>Staggered</> on the Acid Originium Slug. Use <@gd.key>Finisher DMG</> and/or the Axe Armorbeast's ramming to defeat the Acid Originium Slug.

desc.cn: 利用工业爆炸物击败来袭的敌人，保护物资。
desc.en: Use Industrial Explosives to defeat the attacking enemies and protect the supplies.

title.cn: 生存特训 - 城堡准则

desc.cn: 原生钳兽死亡时会<@gd.key>对周围的敌人持续造成伤害</>，善加利用可显著提升战斗效率。
desc.en: When killed, the Indigenous Pincerbeast <@gd.key>continuously deals DMG to nearby enemies</>. Use this well to boost your combat efficiency.

title.cn: 生存特训 - 城堡准则

desc.cn: 火雾源石虫死亡时会<@gd.key>吸附周围的敌人</>，善加利用可显著提升战斗效率。
desc.en: When killed, the Firemist Originium Slug <@gd.key>pulls in nearby enemies</>. Use this well to boost your combat efficiency.

title.cn: 生存特训 - 城堡准则

desc.cn: 引诱斧甲兽撞击石块，使其进入<@gd.key>失衡状态</>后，再利用<@gd.key>处决伤害</>将其击败。
desc.en: Get into position so that the Axe Armorbeast rams the rock and applies <@gd.key>Staggered</> to itself, then use <@gd.key>Finisher DMG</> to defeat the beast.

title.cn: 生存特训 - 野性苦果

desc.cn: 引诱斧甲兽撞击酸液源石虫，使酸液源石虫进入<@gd.key>失衡状态</>后，再利用<@gd.key>处决伤害</>或者斧甲兽的撞击击败酸液源石虫。
desc.en: Position yourself so that the Axe Armorbeast rams and applies <@gd.key>Staggered</> on the Acid Originium Slug. Use <@gd.key>Finisher DMG</> and/or the Axe Armorbeast's ramming to defeat the Acid Originium Slug.

title.cn: 生存特训 - 最终考核

desc.cn:
在「根脉奇境」中，挑战由多条<@gd.key>通路</>和多个<@gd.key>房间</>构成。
在规定时间内，通过收集尽可能多的<@gd.key>「醚质残块」</>来获得<@gd.key>「根脉历程积分」</>，并领取奖励。
desc.en: [The Rooted Realm] is a challenge comprising multiple <@gd.key>routes</> and <@gd.key>chambers</>. The goal is to collect as many <@gd.key>[Aurylene Fragments]</> as you can before the timer ends. This will provide <@gd.key>[Realm Journey Points]</> that lets you claim rewards.

desc.cn:
每条通路有<@gd.key>倒计时</>，需要在倒计时结束前抵达下一个房间，否则会导致<@gd.key>挑战中断</>。
通路上散落着醚质残块，以及可获得醚质残块的<@gd.key>杂物箱</>和<@gd.key>压力开关</>，请尽可能多地收集它们吧。
desc.en: Each route has a <@gd.key>timer</>. Failing to reach the next chamber before the timer runs out will <@gd.key>end the challenge</>. Aurylene Fragments as well as <@gd.key>wooden crates</> and <@gd.key>pressure switches</> containing the fragments can also be found along the way. Try to collect as many of them as you can.

desc.cn: 抵达房间后，可以通过传送入口传送至一处存在<@gd.key>特殊机制</>的战斗场地，请在规定时间内获得尽可能多的醚质残块。
desc.en: After reaching a chamber, use the portal within it to teleport to a combat arena with <@gd.key>special mechanics</>. Likewise, try to collect as many Aurylene Fragments as you can from these arenas before the timer ends.

desc.cn:
在通路中无法使用干员技能。
进入战斗场地后，可以正常使用干员技能。
desc.en: Operator skills cannot be used in the routes. They can only be used normally after entering the combat arena.

desc.cn: 通路中存在一些特殊的<@gd.key>牵引醚质</>和<@gd.key>扩增醚质</>，拾取后可以更快收集醚质残块。
desc.en: Some routes have special <@gd.key>Aurylene Magnet</> and <@gd.key>Aurylene Multiplier</> pick-ups that let you gather more Aurylene Fragments quickly.

desc.cn: 留意场景中的<@gd.key>路标</>，按指引前进或能发现<@gd.key>隐藏通路</>。
desc.en: Pay attention to the <@gd.key>route indicators</> of the realm. They might lead you to <@gd.key>hidden routes known as the Trails</>.

desc.cn:
在「根脉奇境」中，挑战由多条<@gd.key>通路</>和多个<@gd.key>房间</>构成。
在规定时间内，通过收集尽可能多的<@gd.key>「醚质残块」</>来获得<@gd.key>「根脉历程积分」</>，并领取奖励。
desc.en: [The Rooted Realm] is a challenge comprising multiple <@gd.key>routes</> and <@gd.key>chambers</>. The goal is to collect as many <@gd.key>[Aurylene Fragments]</> as you can before the timer ends. This will provide <@gd.key>[Realm Journey Points]</> that lets you claim rewards.

desc.cn:
每条通路有<@gd.key>倒计时</>，需要在倒计时结束前抵达下一个房间，否则会导致<@gd.key>挑战中断</>。
通路上散落着醚质残块，以及可获得醚质残块的<@gd.key>杂物箱</>和<@gd.key>压力开关</>，请尽可能多地收集它们吧。
desc.en: Each route has a <@gd.key>timer</>. Failing to reach the next chamber before the timer runs out will <@gd.key>end the challenge</>. Aurylene Fragments as well as <@gd.key>wooden crates</> and <@gd.key>pressure switches</> containing the fragments can also be found along the way. Try to collect as many of them as you can.

desc.cn: 抵达房间后，可以通过传送入口传送至一处存在<@gd.key>特殊机制</>的战斗场地，请在规定时间内获得尽可能多的醚质残块。
desc.en: After reaching a chamber, use the portal within it to teleport to a combat arena with <@gd.key>special mechanics</>. Likewise, try to collect as many Aurylene Fragments as you can from these arenas before the timer ends.

desc.cn:
在通路中无法使用干员技能。
进入战斗场地后，可以正常使用干员技能。
desc.en: Operator skills cannot be used in the routes. They can only be used normally after entering the combat arena.

desc.cn: 通路中存在一些特殊的<@gd.key>牵引醚质</>和<@gd.key>扩增醚质</>，拾取后可以更快收集醚质残块。
desc.en: Some routes have special <@gd.key>Aurylene Magnet</> and <@gd.key>Aurylene Multiplier</> pick-ups that let you gather more Aurylene Fragments quickly.

desc.cn: 留意场景中的<@gd.key>路标</>，按指引前进或能发现<@gd.key>隐藏通路（隐途）</>。
desc.en: Pay attention to the <@gd.key>route indicators</> of the realm. They might lead you to <@gd.key>hidden routes (Trails)</>.

desc.cn: 「根脉奇境」后3层关卡已开放，越往后探索，可获得的醚质残块越多。
desc.en: The last 3 stages of [The Rooted Realm] are now available. Keep exploring. You'll gather more Aurylene Fragments as you go deeper into the stages.

desc.cn: 根脉历程和奇境任务也更新了，完成后可获得更多奖励。
desc.en: Realm Quests and Rooted Journey have been updated. Complete them to earn even more rewards.

desc.cn:
通过装备精锻系统，可提升金色品质装备的各项初始属性。
精锻强化成功后，将固定提升属性数值。每项属性都有精锻强化成功次数上限。
desc.en:
Use Gear Artificing to improve various base stats of gold-quality gear. 
Successful artificing gives a fixed stat increase. Every stat has a limit to the number of successful artificing attempts.

desc.cn: 每次装备精锻需耗费<@gd.key>金色品质装备</>和<@gd.key>装备精锻助剂</>。
desc.en: Each artificing attempt costs <@gd.key>gold-quality gear</> and <@gd.key>gear artificing catalyst</>.

desc.cn: 装备精锻助剂的所属地区必须与待精锻装备相同。管理员可在各<@gd.key>地区调度员</>处兑换装备精锻助剂。
desc.en: There are different regional Gear Artificing Catalysts and they must match the region of the gear to be artificed. Purchase the catalysts from various <@gd.key>regional stock redistributors</>.

desc.cn: 当装备作为精锻耗材时，必须与待精锻装备<@gd.key>所属部位类型</>相同。
desc.en: The gear used as artificing material must share the <@gd.key>type (armor, gloves, or kits)</> of the target gear to be artificed. For example, only armor can be used to artifice another armor.

desc.cn: 当装备作为精锻耗材时，该装备必须<@gd.key>含有待精锻属性</>，且该属性未强化前的初始值<@gd.key>不小于</>待精锻装备对应属性的初始值。
desc.en: The gear used as artificing material must have <@gd.key>artifice-able stats</>, and the base value (pre-artificing) of such stats <@gd.key>cannot be smaller</> than those of the target gear to be artificed.

desc.cn:
单次精锻中，可<@gd.key>批量选择</>多件装备作为精锻耗材（至多25件）。
精锻开始后，将按照<@gd.key>选择次序</>依次耗费所选装备。若精锻强化提前成功，则会返还本次精锻未耗费的装备和装备精锻助剂。
desc.en: For an artificing attempt, you can <@gd.key>bulk-select</> up to 25 pieces of gear as artificing materials. Making the artificing attempt will consume the selected pieces of gear, <@gd.key>one at a time, in the order of selection</>. Upon successful artificing, you will receive any piece of gear not consumed as well as Gear Artificing Catalyst made during that artificing attempt.

desc.cn: 通过<@gd.key>一键填充</>功能，可以将多件<@gd.key>未精锻装备</>，按照默认顺序批量选择为精锻耗材。
desc.en: Use the <@gd.key>Auto-Fill</> feature to select multiple pieces of <@gd.key>unartificed gear</> according to a default sequence as the artificing materials.

desc.cn:
若需要将已精锻过的装备作为精锻耗材，仍需在列表中主动选择。
干员穿戴中的装备无法选择为精锻耗材。
desc.en: Artificed gear must be manually selected from the list to be used as artificing material. Gear being equipped by an operator cannot be selected as artificing material.

desc.cn:
每次对装备属性进行精锻时，将积累精锻进度，积累达到上限时，下一次该装备属性精锻强化将<@gd.key>必定成功</>。
不同装备和属性的精锻积累上限略有不同。
desc.en: Performing gear artificing of a particular gear stat builds up artificing progress. Reaching the progress limit <@gd.key>guarantees success</> for the next artificing attempt of this gear stat. Different gear and gear stats have different artificing progress limits.

desc.cn:
装备精锻有较小可能直接强化成功，且清空当前精锻积累。
耗费装备的属性初始值<@gd.key>高于</>待精锻装备初始值时，直接完成精锻强化的可能性略有<@gd.key>提升</>，这些装备将会标记为“<@gd.key>较好适配</>”。
desc.en: Gear artificing attempts have a small chance of direct success. A successful attempt also resets the current artificing progress. Chance of direct success is slightly <@gd.key>improved</> when the gear used as the artificing material has <@gd.key>higher</> base stats than those of the gear to be artificed. Such gear will be given the tag: <@gd.key>Good Match</>.

desc.cn:
金色品质的装备可通过<@gd.key>默认工艺</>和<@gd.key>其他兼容工艺</>进行制造。
制造同件装备的工艺不同，消耗<@gd.key>装备原件的类型、数量和调度券的折扣</>会有所不同。
desc.en: Gold quality gear can now be assembled with its <@gd.key>Default Technique</> or <@gd.key>other compatible techniques</>. Using non-default techniques will require <@gd.key>different types and quantities of gear components and offer different stock bill discounts</>.

desc.cn:
<@gd.key>默认工艺</>会标注在装备图标的左上角。
因装备更新批次不同，默认工艺也可能不同。
desc.en: The <@gd.key>Default Technique</> is indicated by a special mark on the upper left corner of the gear icon. New pieces of gear added for each version may have different default techniques.

desc.cn: 新追加的制造工艺可以<@gd.key>向下兼容</>其他旧有的制造工艺。
desc.en: Newly added assembly techniques are <@gd.key>compatible</> with older techniques.

desc.cn: 使用兼容工艺制造时，消耗的装备原件数量将根据默认工艺的装备原件种类按比例进行折算。
desc.en: When assembling with a compatible technique, the amount of gear components required will be based on the type of gear components used by the Default Technique.

desc.cn: 与此同时，使用<@gd.key>较新追加的工艺</>制造时，消耗的调度券数量会获得一定折扣。
desc.en: Using a <@gd.key>newer (higher tier) technique</> for gear assembly also gives a discount in the stock bills required.

desc.cn: 每件装备可以单独<@gd.key>自定义设置</>可兼容的制造工艺。
desc.en: The assembly technique for each piece of gear can be <@gd.key>individually selected</> from all compatible techniques available.

desc.cn: 在全局工艺设置界面中，可以预览当前所有制造工艺的兼容详情。
desc.en: The Switch All Techniques screen lets you preview compatibility details of all assembly techniques available.

desc.cn:
通过<@gd.key>全局工艺设置</>，可以为所有可兼容的装备批量修改所选制造工艺。
勾选[不覆盖已有自定义设置]选项时，已单独自定义设置过工艺的装备不会被修改。
desc.en: Use the <@gd.key>Switch All Techniques</> screen to bulk switch all compatible gear to the selected assembly technique. Checking the option [Retain Individually Selected Technique(s)] will exclude technique(s) you have individually selected for various piece(s) of gear from this bulk action.

desc.cn:
「战争回响」是<@gd.key>赛季制</>常驻战斗挑战玩法，每个赛季由多个<@gd.key>轮换周期</>构成。
每个轮换周期包含3个关卡（可能包含往期关卡），每个关卡有3个难度（普通、困难、残酷）。
desc.en: [Echoes of War] is a <@gd.key>seasonal</> challenge mode that is permanently available. Each season comprises multiple <@gd.key>cycles</>. Each cycle includes 3 stages (which may include stages from the past). Each stage comes in 3 difficulties: Normal, Hard, and Brutal.

desc.cn:
通关普通难度可达成「1星评级」；通关困难难度可达成「2星评级」；通关残酷难度可达成「3星评级」。
通关残酷难度并完成该关卡的<@gd.key>附加挑战目标</>，可使该关卡评级获得<@gd.key>「增辉」</>。
desc.en: Completing a stage on Normal, Hard, and Brutal difficulties rewards 1★, 2★, and 3★ respectively. Completing a stage in Brutal difficulty and <@gd.key>fulfilling the bonus challenge goals</> adds the <@gd.key>[Lustrous]</> boost to the stage rating.

desc.cn:
同一轮换周期内，3个关卡所获星数之和为该周期的<@gd.key>总评级</>（最高为9星）。
周期轮换后，新周期的关卡星数评级将被<@gd.key>重置</>，需重新挑战以再次获得星数。
desc.en: The highest <@gd.key>Total Rating</> that can be earned from a cycle (by successfully completing 3 stages in Brutal difficulty) is 9★. After a cycle ends, the Total Rating will be <@gd.key>reset</> for the new cycle. Challenge the stages of the new cycle to earn stars again.

desc.cn:
本赛季各轮换周期总评级中的最高者，将作为本赛季的<@gd.key>「最终评级」</>。
根据获得星数（1星/3星/5星/7星/9星），可获得对应的<@gd.key>赛季称号</>。
desc.en: The highest Total Rating earned across all cycles in the season will be the <@gd.key>[Final Rating]</> of the season. The number of stars earned (1★, 3★, 5★, 7★, and 9★) will be used to determine the <@gd.key>season title</> awarded.

desc.cn:
若同一轮换周期内的3个关卡均已获得<@gd.key>「增辉」</>，则该赛季称号也会获得<@gd.key>「增辉」</>。
赛季称号会在好友相关界面展示。
desc.en: Earning the <@gd.key>[Lustrous]</> boost for all 3 stages in a cycle also makes the season title <@gd.key>[Lustrous]</>. The current season title will be displayed at UI screens related to the Friends feature.

desc.cn:
每个关卡会初始解锁普通与困难难度，通关困难难度后解锁残酷难度。解锁残酷难度的关卡在后续轮换和赛季中将永久解锁残酷难度。
若本赛季的赛季称号已获得<@gd.key>「增辉」</>，则下个赛季的所有关卡将直接解锁残酷难度。
desc.en:
When a cycle begins, Normal and Hard difficulty tiers of each stage will be available by default. Complete a stage on Hard difficulty to unlock its Brutal difficulty. Complete a stage on Brutal difficulty to permanently unlock the Brutal difficulty in future cycles and seasons. 
Earning the <@gd.key>[Lustrous]</> boost for the current season title automatically unlocks Brutal difficulty for all stages in the next season.

desc.cn:
当分别首次达成某个关卡的1星、2星或3星评级时，可获得对应评级的<@gd.key>荣勋</>奖励。
每个关卡评级的荣勋奖励为<@gd.key>一次性奖励</>，不会因赛季更新或周期轮换而重置。
desc.en: Earning 1★, 2★, and 3★ ratings for the first time in a stage gives you <@gd.key>Honor</> rewards corresponding to the rating. Honor rewards for each rating of a stage are <@gd.key>one-time rewards</>. They will not reset after season updates or cycle changes.

desc.cn: 管理员可在「战争回响 - 战绩回顾」界面中，查看自己最近6个赛季每个轮换周期的<@gd.key>战绩详情</>（包括各周期的关卡评级与通关编队等）。也可在好友的个人名片中，查看其<@gd.key>最近6个</>赛季的「最终评级」以及达成该评级轮换周期的战绩（若评级相同，优先展示更早的轮换周期）。
desc.en: Go to the [Echoes of War - Battle Review] screen to view <@gd.key>performance details</> (including ratings and team compositions in each stage of the cycle) in every cycle of the 6 most recent seasons. Visit your friends' Profile screen to see their [Final Rating] in the <@gd.key>6 most recent</> seasons and the cycle that achieved the said rating (if the same rating is achieved in several cycles, the earlier cycle is shown).

desc.cn:
每张数据铭牌记录了不同的敌人信息，包括敌人类型、数量、等级。且记录了该铭牌对应的战力点。
战力点代表该数据铭牌的演算难度。
desc.en: Each Dataplate contains different data on enemies, including enemy type, quantity, and levels, as well as the corresponding Battle Point(s). Battle Points represent the difficulty of the Dataplate in the Trial.

title.cn: 选剑演武 - 数据铭牌与战力点
title.en: Trial of Swordmancy: Dataplate and Battle Point

desc.cn:
挑战开始前，可抽取多张数据铭牌。
已抽取铭牌的战力点之和，决定了当局演算成功后可获得的演算奖励。
desc.en: Before starting the challenge, you can draw multiple Dataplates. The sum of Battle Points of the Dataplates you draw determines the amount of rewards earned by successfully completing the Trial.

title.cn: 选剑演武 - 演算奖励

desc.cn:
当战力点之和超过10点时，会导致数据溢出。
演算奖励回滚，挑战难度增加。
请谨慎抽取铭牌，避免数据溢出。
desc.en: Data Overflow happens when the total Battle Points go over 10. This lowers the amount of Trial rewards and makes the Trial more difficult. Make your draws carefully to avoid Data Overflow.

title.cn: 选剑演武 - 数据溢出

desc.cn:
在抽取第三张数据铭牌前，可以开启<@gd.key>奖励翻倍</>。开启后若挑战成功，本局演算会获得双倍奖励。
每日仅有<@gd.key>3次</>机会可以放弃当前抽取结果。若放弃次数耗尽后仍继续放弃，将<@gd.key>会扣除本日奖励演算次数</>。
desc.en:
You can activate <@gd.key>Rewards Doubling</> before making the third draw. Activating this feature and successfully completing the Trial will double the Trial rewards earned.
You have <@gd.key>3</> Abandon attempts per day to abandon your current draw(s). Choosing to Abandon after using up the daily Abandon attempts will <@gd.key>deduct a Rewarded Trial attempt instead</>.

title.cn: 选剑演武 -奖励翻倍与放弃
title.en: Trial of Swordmancy: Rewards Doubling & Abandon

desc.cn:
铭牌库由1~5战力点的数据铭牌构成，可在界面右侧查看铭牌数量。
在抽取过程中可随时查看牌库剩余，得知牌库剩余铭牌情况。
desc.en: The Dataplate deck includes Dataplates with 1 to 5 Battle Points. The right side of the screen shows the number of Dataplates in the deck to keep track of Dataplates left in the deck while drawing.

desc.cn:
铭牌库将每隔三天轮换一次。
轮换后，数据铭牌的数量以及敌人类型会发生变化。
desc.en: The Dataplate deck resets once every 3 days. Resetting changes the size of the Dataplate deck and the enemy types on the Dataplates.

title.cn: 选剑演武 - 铭牌库轮换

desc.cn:
在自由演算模式下，演算次数将不受限制，但演算成功后不会获得任何奖励。
每日自由演算超过一定次数后，选剑演武挑战中敌人掉落的奖励将大幅减少。该效果将会在次日重置。
desc.en: Free Trial Mode imposes no limit on the number of Trials you attempt, but completing the trial does not give you any rewards. After completing a certain number of Free Trials in a day, enemy drops in the Trial of Swordmancy will be greatly reduced. This effect is reset on the following day.

title.cn: 选剑演武 -自由演算模式
title.en: Trial of Swordmancy: Free Trial Mode

desc.cn:
谷地像差中有着大量未知的秘宝，同时也有着足以危及性命的紊乱环境，在其中会不断增长紊乱值。 
管理员需要在紊乱值达到临界前，尽可能搜集更多的物品。
desc.en:
Numerous unknown secrets and valuables exist within the Valley's Aberrants, but ambient Derangement is extremely hazardous and will increase with time.
Endministrator, try to collect as many items as possible before Derangement reaches its limit.

desc.cn:
在谷地像差中，存在大量沉积晶石，将其破坏后会暴露其核心，与之交互可获得沉积结核。
也可与各种储物点交互获得沉积具象物。
但需注意，这些行为都会使紊乱值增长。
desc.en:
Many Precipitation Crystals exist in Valley's Aberrants. Smash the crystal to expose its core, then interact with it to get precipitation nodules.
Interact with various storage points to acquire precipitation manifests.
Be careful, though. These actions will cause Derangement to increase.

desc.cn:
探索中获得的沉积结核会保存在隔绝封装器中。
隔绝封装器具有一定的容量上限，达到上限时，便无法获得更多沉积结核。
desc.en:
Precipitation nodules found during exploration are stored in the Isolation Container.
The Isolation Container has a limited capacity and cannot hold more precipitation nodules when full.

desc.cn:
谷地像差中存在各种敌人，有些资源需要击败看守的敌人后才能获得。
在战斗中，会额外持续增长紊乱值。
desc.en:
There are all sorts of enemies in the Valley's Aberrants. Some enemies must be first defeated to acquire certain resources.
Fighting battles will also cause Derangement to increase.

desc.cn: 完成阿奎多发布的各类委托，可以获得奖励，并可解锁辅助探测技术，提升在谷地像差中的探索能力。
desc.en: Complete Aquito's commissions to earn rewards and unlock exploration support tech. These tech will make exploration easier in the Valley's Aberrants.

desc.cn: 通过带出沉积结核或是完成某些委托，可以积累行动刻度，进而获得奖励，请记得领取。
desc.en: Earn operation metrics and rewards by successfully bringing out precipitation nodules or completing certain commissions. Don't forget to claim them.
